label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 151
title: EPIC: Product one-stop page (Project Management + Product modes) - per-product dynamic page
body:
## Problem / why
There is no single place to see a product being built (progress/features/quality) and, once built, to
present/launch/operate it. Builders and owners currently have no one-stop page.

## Goal & value
One route per product with TWO tabs (Project Management | Product), default driven by lifecycle, that is
DERIVED from backend truth. Separate from pipeline-engineer/engine pages (linked, not merged).

## Sub-items
- BI-0148 Project Management tab (during build)
- BI-0149 Product tab (after build)

## Out of scope
Pipeline-engineer pages (stage runner/logs/model router) - separate.

## Links
docs/product-portal.md; backend BI-0215..0218.
